mechanisms.interface: model could not express a legal call: undeclared or wrong-typed argument, unknown action, turn with no tool call
mechanisms.budget: legal call refused because its quoted cost exceeded the remaining budget (BudgetExceeded)
mechanisms.sequencing: legal, affordable call that violated an evidence precondition (premature BACKWARD / OPTIMIZE / other)

narrow_window_canonical_rule: a run uses narrow-window allocation iff it builds at least one process window with n_states strictly less than the full admissible state set (14136) AND at least one later scoped action (OPTIMIZE_PROCESS, RUN_MC, TEST_LEVER, BACKWARD, CHECK_MODEL_VALIDITY) succeeds against that window
narrow_window_legacy_rule: any BUILD_PROCESS_WINDOW call carrying a non-empty bounds argument (counts full-domain bounds as narrow)
